Each NAME.json is the stdout of `atlc run examples/NAME.toml` and NAME.args the args of `atlc spec examples/NAME.toml --json` (one per line, the examples directory written @EXAMPLES@), from atlc 27b912a against algotradelib a08fb97.
@EXAMPLES@ is now cmdatl's examples/, copies of atlc 0fad370's examples, which differ from 27b912a's in comments only.
To re-record after the examples, atlc's report or the library's report change: run those two commands again on cmdatl's examples/ with an atlc that still has them (27b912a) and the library, and write each output over its file, the examples directory replaced by @EXAMPLES@.
universe.json and universe.args were recorded again from cmdatl's own backtest driver when `replay.fill = "legs"` gave way to `data.open_point` (now `bars.open_point`), `replay.market = "us"` and the decision-close rule (`examples/decision-close.hpp`): the same 520 fills and closing equity; two bars a day instead of three (bars, per-period ratios, gaps, first and last bar change); the caveats gain the rule and the session counts.
On 2026-11-05 every `data.*` argument in the `.args` files was renamed `bars.*` by hand, when the run spec's `[data]` table became `[bars]`; no report changed.
